chunks: Remember that devotion is exclusively for God. Those who have taken protectors other than Him, say: 'We worship them that they may bring us nearer to God.' Surely God will judge between them in what they are differing about. Verily God does not show the way to an ungrateful liar.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about those who take allies besides God to draw closer to Him?
ai.summary: This verse, central to the concept of Tawhid al-Ibadah, distinguishes between pure monotheism and the subtle polytheism (Shirk) of those who seek intercessors, a key theme in Shia exegesis regarding the status of the Ahl al-Bayt as valid intercessors versus false idols. It highlights that God will adjudicate the disputes among these groups, ultimately guiding neither the deceitful liar nor the ungrateful disbeliever, underscoring the necessity of sincere, undivided devotion.
